# Expense tracker context (2026-09-28)

## Project and specs
- Python 3.14 FastAPI expense categorizer; dependencies and checks use `uv`. UI is vanilla JavaScript with Pico CSS; allowed categories are configured via `CATEGORIES`.
- Runtime exposes `/health` and `/ready`, serves the UI at `/` and `/ui`, and validates required columns on upload. Full categorized CSV artifacts are stored under `.tmp`.
- Uploads accept CSV/XLS/XLSX, normalize categorized rows, derive `who`, and provide a full CSV download. Reporting uses short-lived dataset IDs, validated summary/filter APIs, and explicit full and filtered exports.
- Dashboard filters support repeated category/person values: categories combine with OR, category and person filters with AND. Amounts are signed/net; valid empty results return zero totals. UI uses Chart.js 4.5.1 from a pinned frontend dependency, vendors its UMD build locally (no runtime CDN), updates a responsive category doughnut chart with filters, shows negative net categories in red using absolute slice sizes, and retains signed tooltips, equivalent tables, and safe DOM `textContent` rendering.
- Specs cover configuration, logging/observability, security, resilience, deployment, testing/CI, dataset summaries, dashboard, exports/rendering, regression QA, and rollout documentation. Production follow-up includes persistent storage and operational hardening.

## Completed Gemini migration
- Replaced deprecated `google-generativeai` with `google-genai`; retained JSON-schema categorization, configured request timeout, transient API/HTTP retries, heuristic fallback, and deterministic client cleanup.
- Updated compatible `httpx`/`websockets` ranges and lockfile. Tests now isolate local `.env` credentials/categories and assert the SDK request contract and exact fallback categories.
- PR #52 merged to `master` (`a9aeefb`). Review feedback was addressed in the PR; no open review threads remained at last check.

## Validation and caveat
- `uv run pytest`: 41 passed. `uv run ruff format --check`, `uv run ruff check`, and `uv run ty check` passed.
